**What this changes**
A sentence or two.

**Why**
The motivation — the problem it solves or the behaviour it improves.

**Checklist**
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) if user-facing
- [ ] Kept the core dependency-free (new deps behind an optional extra)
